name: Pillar
description: Connect Claude to your Pillar security environment. This extension provides 7 tools to explore and analyze your AI lifecycle security posture including full asset inventory identified security issues, runtime events, findings,  red teaming assessments and our full documentation. Use natural language to assess risk, investigate threats, generate reports, onboard security teams, and prioritize remediation across your entire AI lifecycle.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pillar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pillar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pillar.security/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pillar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pillar provides these MCP tools: get_asset_details, get_redgraph_result, list_ai_assets, list_findings, list_runtime_activity, pillar_get_doc, and pillar_search_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pillar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pillar in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Pillar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pillar is developed by Pillar Security Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
